decision: Announced identity-only successor for the root Cargo.lock change from API-01 (#467: the new jope-api contract crate adds one 9-line local lock entry depending only on schemars, serde and serde_json, before API-06 registers it as a workspace member), after the RNK-11 CPU-closure lockfile identity.
